name: Terminal station failure on a LOOP → park the bound run toward the human
description: The loop-fired half of the station-failure park (station-failure-parks D2). For the LOOP-dispatched stations — validation (coordinator/03 fires on the coordinator loop), floors (dev-from-task/05 on the developer loop), verify (07a on the review loop), per the dispatch-entity census pin — station.dispatch.failed lands on that LOOP, so this rule fires on the loop (entity pattern *.*.agent.agentic-loop.execution.*) and reaches the run through the loop's agent.run.entity-id anchor (the 06d donor binding; the ne "" guard is the run-less guard — without an anchor the subject substitution cannot resolve and the park would be silently dropped, run-lifecycle/03 precedent). CROSS-ENTITY GUARDS ARE DELIBERATELY OMITTED: rule conditions read the FIRING entity only, and the loop carries neither run.awaiting.human nor delivery.pr.ref — a guard on a SIBLING entity's stamp is racy ALWAYS (the engine writes each rule action as its own KV revision and evaluates against fetched state; the routing-upgrades double-dispatch lesson). The one-shot station.park.routed marker on the loop is the sole re-fire protection, so a loop-fired park landing on an ALREADY-parked run APPENDS a second run.awaiting.human triple (graph-ingest AddTriple is an unconditional append — the e2e add-semantics pin documents it). That duplicate is BENIGN for every consumer (presence checks length_eq 0 / message display) and is the accepted D2 trade: at most once per FAILURE via the marker, not at most one park triple per run. on_enter records run.awaiting.human on the run FIRST (park-first — a marker-set-park-absent crash window would be a permanent stall; the re-fire this allows lands only the documented benign duplicate, see restart_safe), then the loop-scoped marker, then posts to the user-response bus; the park message names the failed station via substitution of the stamped object (D3). Transition rule-owned (G2); park-rule writer (G5, sanctioned realization).

metadata.trigger_rationale: station.dispatch.failed length_gte 1 on an agentic-loop entity = a LOOP-dispatched station (validation/floors/verify) exhausted its retries. The entity-pattern split with rule 05 (chain pattern) makes the halves mutually exclusive by construction.
metadata.writer_note: run.awaiting.human via the park-rule subsystem (G5); station.park.routed is the park rules' own fired-once marker. Rule add_triple stamps the engine's generic Source 'rule_engine', so the vocab's park-rule writer is a SUBSYSTEM label; the sanctioned-park-writers census is the honest tie.
metadata.restart_safe: PARK-FIRST ordering (each action its own KV revision): run.awaiting.human lands before the LOOP-scoped station.park.routed marker, so a crash between them RE-FIRES on replay (marker still absent) and lands the already-documented BENIGN duplicate park + the notification — never a marker-set-park-absent permanent stall (marker-first had that window). The marker stays the extinguisher for the completed sequence (a run-scoped guard would read absent on the loop and re-post every rescan — the 06d lesson). The 06d donor's marker-FIRST rationale does not transfer here: its guarded action is a non-idempotent publish_agent spawn; this rule's guarded actions are a benign-duplicate add_triple and a user notification.
